body:
Adds `research/gyro-twin` (stylised, pure Python, 8 tests): a gyro twin calibrated on white angle-random-walk noise vs a real sensor with a random-walking bias. Heading variance ratio is exactly 1+(t/t*)², the twin's re-alignment interval is 24× too long, a single-point Allan fit is right at one horizon only, and dead-reckoning range is over-stated 1.25–1.74×. README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
